name: size-fit-picker
title: Size Fit Picker
description: Size picker that converts UK, US, EU and IN sizes live without losing the pick, reads back the shopper's usual size adjusted for brands that run small or large, and catches their usual number clicked in the wrong system with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Wrong shoe or clothing size ordered
meta.summary: Converts UK, US, EU and IN sizes live and catches a usual size clicked in the wrong system, like US 8 picked as UK 8.
catches: The usual size number picked in the wrong system
Brand fit offsets (runs small or large)
Switching display systems without changing the pick
Sizes without an equivalent in a system
limits: Ships with typical men's shoe, women's shoe and women's clothing charts; brands vary
Fit offsets come from your data
a11y: System and size pickers are radiogroups with arrow, Home and End keys

rules.note: Built-in size charts are general conversions, not an official standard; not verified against a primary source. Use your brand's own chart.
